enabled.description: Whether OAuth2 settings are enabled or not

edgeEnabled.description: Whether OAuth2 settings are enabled on Edge or not

oauth2ParamsInfos.description: List of configured OAuth2 clients. Cannot contain null values

JsonNode.description: A value representing the any type (object or primitive)

emailAttributeKey.description: Email attribute key of OAuth2 principal attributes. Must be specified for BASIC mapper type and cannot be specified for GITHUB type

tenantNameStrategy.description: Tenant naming strategy. For DOMAIN type, domain for tenant name will be taken from the email (substring before '@')

tenantNamePattern.description: Tenant name pattern for CUSTOM naming strategy. OAuth2 attributes in the pattern can be used by enclosing attribute key in '%{' and '}'

customerNamePattern.description: Customer name pattern. When creating a user on the first OAuth2 log in, if specified, customer name will be used to create or find existing customer in the platform and assign customerId to the user

defaultDashboardName.description: Name of the tenant's dashboard to set as default dashboard for newly created user

alwaysFullScreen.description: Whether default dashboard should be open in full screen

scheme.description: Domain scheme. Mixed scheme means than both HTTP and HTTPS are going to be used

allowUserCreation.description: Whether user should be created if not yet present on the platform after successful authentication

activateUser.description: Whether user credentials should be activated when user is created after successful authentication

type.description: Type of OAuth2 mapper. Depending on this param, different mapper config fields must be specified

basic.description: Mapper config for BASIC and GITHUB mapper types

custom.description: Mapper config for CUSTOM mapper type

pkgName.description: Application package name. Cannot be empty

appSecret.description: Application secret. The length must be at least 16 characters

domainInfos.description: List of configured domains where OAuth2 platform will redirect a user after successful authentication. Cannot be empty. There have to be only one domain with specific name with scheme type 'MIXED'. Configured domains with the same name must have different scheme types

mobileInfos.description: Mobile applications settings. Application package name must be unique within the list

clientRegistrations.description: List of OAuth2 provider settings. Cannot be empty

mapperConfig.description: Config for mapping OAuth2 log in response to platform entities

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID. Cannot be empty

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Cannot be empty

authorizationUri.description: Authorization URI of the OAuth2 provider. Cannot be empty

accessTokenUri.description: Access token URI of the OAuth2 provider. Cannot be empty

scope.description: OAuth scopes that will be requested from OAuth2 platform. Cannot be empty

userInfoUri.description: User info URI of the OAuth2 provider

userNameAttributeName.description: Name of the username attribute in OAuth2 provider response. Cannot be empty

jwkSetUri.description: JSON Web Key URI of the OAuth2 provider

clientAuthenticationMethod.description: Client authentication method to use: 'BASIC' or 'POST'. Cannot be empty

loginButtonLabel.description: OAuth2 provider label. Cannot be empty

loginButtonIcon.description: Log in button icon for OAuth2 provider

platforms.description: List of platforms for which usage of the OAuth2 client is allowed (empty for all allowed)

additionalInfo.description: Additional info of OAuth2 client (e.g. providerName)
